subthemes.name: Making images from text descriptions
subthemes.gist: Papers on turning written descriptions into images, including ways to control specific attributes, edit existing images, and personalize outputs without retraining the model.

subthemes.name: Generating video from images or descriptions
subthemes.gist: Papers on creating video sequences, including techniques to generate motion, extend videos infinitely, combine images, and control the motion that appears on screen.

subthemes.name: Building 3D shapes and scenes
subthemes.gist: Papers on creating three-dimensional objects and complete scenes, including techniques to generate parts, preserve identity, and build detailed 3D environments from descriptions.

subthemes.name: Faster and more efficient generation
subthemes.gist: Papers on speeding up generation while keeping quality high, including distillation (learning from larger models), few-step sampling, and compression techniques.

subthemes.name: Mathematical foundations and new generation methods
subthemes.gist: Papers on the underlying math that makes generation work, including flow matching, diffusion across different data types, and improved sampling algorithms.

subthemes.name: Generating language and text
subthemes.gist: Papers on using diffusion and generative approaches to create text, including language models, speech synthesis, and music generation.

subthemes.name: Using generation to solve problems
subthemes.gist: Papers that use generative models to answer difficult questions or fix broken data, including solving math problems, restoring damaged images, and improving data quality.

subthemes.name: Training and controlling generative models
subthemes.gist: Papers on how to train models more stably, guide them with preferences, and align their outputs with what users actually want.

subthemes.name: Creating multiple data types together
subthemes.gist: Papers on generating images paired with other information (text, graphs, molecules, molecular descriptions) or combining different types of input to create richer outputs.

subthemes.name: Specialized techniques for better results
subthemes.gist: Papers on specific tricks and improvements to make generation work better, including better tokenization, improved caching, and smarter ways to use models during generation.
